policy_en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). Later same-day snapshots (14:52, 16:36) are additional public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. After a print, append a result snapshot without rewriting the freeze file.
policy_zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。同日稍后快照（14:52、16:36）是 9/15–16 FOMC 的追加事前公开冻结。公布后只追加结果快照，不改写冻结文件。

snapshots.note_en: First public snapshot. CPI/NFP freezes inside were internal before this commit.
snapshots.note_zh: 第一次公开快照。其中 CPI/非农冻结在此 commit 之前只在内部。

snapshots.note_en: Adds watch list, status fields, and pre-print labeling. Same 10:20 scan.
snapshots.note_zh: 补观察名单、状态字段和事前标记。扫描仍是 10:20。

snapshots.note_en: Forced FOMC pre-print freeze within 48h. Scan 16:24 CST: CME hike-bin 92.1% vs PM +25bp 79.5% (gap 12.6pp). after_audit 0.
snapshots.note_zh: 距 FOMC 不足 48 小时强制事前冻结。16:24 CST 扫描：CME 加息档 92.1% 对 PM +25bp 79.5%（缺口 12.6pp）。审计后 0。
